author: agent:claude-code
message: Every host now has a test: nix/scripts/check-hosts.sh evaluates each system and home configuration without building, registered on the root so it reaches every part. Closes the flake-checks todo; `nix flake check` + CI wait on the hardware configs. (proposal 01a122ca-4c02-71bd-9622-ecf0d85dc150, proposed by agent:claude-code, accepted by user)

check.name: check-hosts
check.notes: Evaluates every nixosConfigurations / darwinConfigurations toplevel and every homeConfigurations activationPackage (drvPath only, nothing is built). NixOS hosts without hardware-configuration.nix in git report PENDING and don't fail. On Linux or macOS: `bash nix/scripts/check-hosts.sh` or `just check-hosts`. Verified 2026-10-09: all ok or pending (exit 0); a control copy with an undefined option on vgwsl2 failed with the option's error (exit 1).

title: Host checks are an eval-only script, not `nix flake check` (yet)
body: `nix flake check` evaluates every nixosConfigurations entry, so it cannot pass until vgnixmini, vgsquid-azul and vgsquid-onyx have hardware-configuration.nix (generated on each machine). nix/scripts/check-hosts.sh evaluates each system and home configuration's drvPath, reports those hosts as PENDING, and fails only on real errors, so it is usable as a regression check today. Moving to flake `checks` + CI (baseline rule nix.flake-check) waits on the three hardware configs.

title: Flake `checks` and CI running `nix flake check`
body: Once every bare-metal host has its hardware-configuration.nix: expose the check-hosts evaluations as flake `checks` (forAllSystems, eval-only derivations), and add CI with DeterminateSystems/nix-installer-action running `nix flake check -L` on Linux and macOS (baseline rule nix.flake-check).

title: `tend:` header comments on the nix modules
body: impl_score's docs gap: each module's default.nix (and the flakes) starts with a comment saying what it's for and a `tend: <node path>` line naming its part. Mechanical, about 60 files.
